description:
Search Cryptowisser news by keywords. How matching works:
- If the whole query is a known coin, company, person, regulator or country (names, tickers and aliases like "ETH" or "CZ" work), you get articles tagged with that entity.
- Otherwise an article matches only if EVERY keyword appears in its headline or summary. Matching is case-insensitive and on partial words ("ETF" also matches "ETFs"). There are no synonyms and no relevance ranking.
- Queries of 1 to 3 distinctive keywords work best: "bitcoin price" matches articles, while a full question like "why is bitcoin down" usually matches nothing. Every extra keyword narrows the results.
- Results are newest first, and from/to limit them to a specific period.

from.description: Optional. Only articles published on or after this date or datetime (ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-09-01").

limit.description: Number of articles to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 5.

query.description: 1 to 3 distinctive keywords, or a coin, company or person name.

to.description: Optional. Only articles published on or before this date or datetime. Defaults to now.

name: search-news
title: Search News
